item.title: Jensen Huang may be out at Nvidia: The rise and fall of a key figure in the AI boom
item.description: Reports suggest the leather-jacket-clad Nvidia CEO will soon be ousted from the chipmaker for a series of alleged extramarital affairs. What will his potential exit mean for the company he built into the powerhouse it is today? Jensen Huang has, for more than three decades, been the driving force behind Nvidia, transforming a video game graphic chipmaker into one of the most impactful companies of the AI era. Now, in a remarkable turn of events, the 63-year-old CEO may be on his way out....
